review_decisions.meaning: Candidate improved the source run enough to draft a new strategy version for manual review.
Candidate is interesting but not strong enough to promote yet. Keep comparing across more symbols or ranges.
Candidate has too few trades or too narrow a segment. Collect more evidence before changing strategy settings.
Candidate indicates rules/segment are broken, too strict, or structurally weak. Repair logic rather than tune threshold only.
Candidate underperformed the source run. Do not promote.

promotion_guardrails: Do not auto-apply to live scanner.
Do not overwrite existing strategy versions.
Use strategy draft JSON as a manual input to the Strategy Library editor.
Prefer side/regime-specific evidence over blended PnL.
